'''Inverting''' is a means of hiding weaves of the [[One Power]]. An inverted weave is manipulated such that only the channeler that wove it can detect it.{{ref|{{twotc}}, inverted weave}}

It is first seen taught by [[Asmodean]]{{ref/book|5|3}} to [[Rand al'Thor]], when he goes back to the [[Stone of Tear]] and inverts his weaves around ''[[Callandor]]''. {{ref/book|6|32}}

[[Moghedien]], while trapped and collared by the ''[[a'dam]],'' teaches [[Elayne]] and [[Nynaeve]] how to invert their weaves.{{ref/book|6|Prologue}} They teach [[Egwene]] who in turn teaches the rest of the [[Aes Sedai]] in [[Salidar]].{{ref/book|7|9}} [[Cadsuane]] had learned inversion sometime before the [[Battle near Shadar Logoth]].{{ref/book|9|35}}

The act of inverting a weave is referred to as "reversing" by various Forsaken.{{Ref/book|9|35}}
